question: On what basis is Kuṇḍalinī-śakti identified with the śaktikūṭa, O great goddess?
premises: The preceding teaching establishes the enchanting efficacy of the kāma-principle.
Kuṇḍalinī-śakti is named as the operative power in this context.
The śaktikūṭa is specified as the locus of that power.
inference: Therefore Kuṇḍalinī-śakti is to be understood as situated in the śaktikūṭa.
uncertainties: Whether śaktikūṭe refers to a mantra-section or a locus in the śrīcakra is not explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: Therefore, O great goddess, the Kuṇḍalinī power is in the śaktikūṭa.
